title: White Silence
description: A modpack that radically changes the gameplay: players must survive in the harsh conditions of an endless winter
body:
# About
White Silence is a survival modpack set in harsh conditions: bitter cold, blizzards that block out the sun, and a shortage of food!
## Content
- The Eternal Blizzard: A snowstorm rages on the surface, blocking out the light. The cold is biting, and nothing grows—what can help in such conditions?
- Use Сreate to invent mechanisms that ease suffering.
- Amazing ambient soundtracks.
- The oppressive atmosphere of darkness. What creatures does the snowstorm conceal?
- How do you survive when food isn't growing and animals are freezing to death? The "Let's do!" collection will help you with food and fine wine!
- To create an even more oppressive atmosphere, dark shaders are enabled by default.
- Capture all the wonders and horrors of endless winter with Exposure.
## In development
Custom bosses, enemies, and survival tools. Unique spawn mechanics and difficulty levels. Custom loading screen.
